title: Google Search Console
description: Reads Search Console properties and search analytics (clicks, impressions, CTR, position) with the org's bound Google account. The add-on calls the Search Console API; the token stays host-side.

permissions.reason: Call the Google Search Console API with the bound account
Use the Google account bound to the search console connection

descriptor.name: search-console
descriptor.title: Google Search Console tools
descriptor.description: List verified sites and query search analytics

tools.name: list_sites
tools.description: List Search Console properties accessible by the bound account with their permission levels.

accountId.description: Bound Google account id; required only when several accounts are bound

tools.name: search_analytics
tools.description: Query Search Console search analytics for a verified site: clicks, impressions, CTR and average position grouped by dimensions.

dimensions.description: Comma-separated dimensions: query, page, date, device, country

accountId.description: Bound Google account id; required only when several accounts are bound
